tools.name: lookup_company
tools.description: Look up a UK company by company number. Returns register details, latest financials (iXBRL figures as filed at Companies House and/or AI-extracted estimates from PDF accounts), risk signals and trajectory. Note: 'Total assets less current liabilities' and 'Creditors' are reported as filed; dates are

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Search UK companies by financial criteria. Returns up to 50 matches.

tools.name: compare_companies
tools.description: Compare two UK companies side by side.

tools.name: market_stats
tools.description: Get aggregate market statistics across all companies in the database.

tools.name: find_triggers
tools.description: Find companies matching specific financial triggers useful for B2B lead generation.

tools.name: search_by_name
tools.description: Search all UK companies (Companies House register, ~5.6M) by name. Ranking: exact name match (ignoring LTD/LIMITED/PLC etc.) first, then active companies, then names starting with or containing the phrase, then other matches (words match as prefixes). Returns company numbers for lookup_company.

tools.name: recent_changes
tools.description: List companies whose iXBRL accounts were published at Companies House in the last N days (by publication date; each row also shows the balance sheet date). Useful for monitoring a watchlist or finding fresh signal.

tools.name: watch_add
tools.description: Add UK companies (by company number) to your monitoring watchlist. The current Companies House state is snapshotted; get_alerts then reports status changes, overdue accounts, new accounts, new charges and financial deterioration. Watchlist size: 5 companies on Free, 50 on Pro.

tools.name: watch_remove
tools.description: Remove companies from your monitoring watchlist.

tools.name: watch_list
tools.description: Show your monitoring watchlist with each company's current status, accounts due date and latest balance sheet date.

tools.name: get_alerts
tools.description: Monitoring alerts for your watchlist: status changes (liquidation, administration, strike-off), overdue accounts, newly registered or published accounts, new charges, negative net assets, and drops of 30%+ in net assets or cash between the last two iXBRL accounts. Sorted by severity.
